```yaml
name: Docs Automation

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: 'Whether to run Claude Code'
        required: true
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
      create_pr:
        description: 'Whether to create PR in docs-new'
        required: true
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
      max_turns:
        description: 'Max Claude turns (increase if hitting limit)'
        required: true
        default: '50'
        type: number

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout InstantSearch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Determine Release Version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "release" ]; then
            echo "version=${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            # For manual trigger, use latest tag or HEAD
            echo "version=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Generate Changelog Context
        id: changelog
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          # Extract changelog for the specific version
          # Assuming CHANGELOG.md exists and follows standard format
          if [ -f CHANGELOG.md ]; then
            # Simple extraction: get content between version header and next header
            CHANGELOG_CONTENT=$(awk "/## \[${VERSION}\]/,/## \[/ { if (/## \[${VERSION}\]/) {p=1; next} if (p && /^## \[/) {exit} if (p) print }" CHANGELOG.md)
            echo "$CHANGELOG_CONTENT" > /tmp/release_changelog.md
            echo "has_changelog=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_changelog=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Checkout docs-new repository
        if: steps.changelog.outputs.has_changelog == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: algolia/docs-new
          token: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          path: docs-new
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: steps.changelog.outputs.has_changelog == 'true' && (github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true' || github.event_name == 'release')
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt_file: /tmp/claude_prompt.txt
          allowed_tools: "Bash,Read,Write,Edit"
          max_turns: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_turns || 50 }}
          timeout_minutes: 15
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Prepare Claude Prompt
        if: steps.changelog.outputs.has_changelog == 'true' && (github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true' || github.event_name == 'release')
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          cat > /tmp/claude_prompt.txt << EOF
          You are a documentation automation assistant. Your task is to update the documentation in the \`docs-new\` repository based on the release changelog for InstantSearch version $VERSION.

          ## Context
          - Repository: algolia/instantsearch
          - Release Version: $VERSION
          - Changelog: See attached file \`/tmp/release_changelog.md\`

          ## Flavor Mapping
          Map InstantSearch packages to documentation file extensions:
          - \`instantsearch.js\` -> \`.js.mdx\`
          - \`react-instantsearch\` -> \`.react.mdx\`
          - \`vue-instantsearch\` -> \`.vue.mdx\`

          ## Instructions
          1. Read the changelog from \`/tmp/release_changelog.md\`.
          2. Identify changes relevant to each framework (JS, React, Vue).
          3. Locate the corresponding \`.mdx\` files in the \`docs-new\` directory.
          4. Update the documentation files to reflect the changes in the changelog.
          5. Ensure all changes are consistent and accurate.
          6. Do not create new files unless necessary.
          7. Commit your changes with a message: "docs: update docs for InstantSearch $VERSION"

          ## Constraints
          - Only modify files in the \`docs-new\` directory.
          - Do not modify any configuration files or scripts.
          - If a change is not clear, skip it rather than guessing.
          EOF

      - name: Create Pull Request in docs-new
        if: steps.changelog.outputs.has_changelog == 'true' && (github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'true' || github.event_name == 'release')
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
          path: docs-new
          commit-message: "docs: update docs for InstantSearch ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          title: "docs: update docs for InstantSearch ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          body: |
            This PR updates the documentation for InstantSearch version ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}.

            ## Changes
            - Updated documentation based on release changelog.
            - Mapped changes to appropriate framework flavors (JS, React, Vue).

            ## Review
            - Please review the changes for accuracy and completeness.
            - Assign to \`frontend-experiences-web\` team for review.
          branch: "docs-automation/${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          draft: true
          labels: "documentation"
          reviewers: "algolia/frontend-experiences-web"
```
